evals.prompt: Review a completed implementation wave before accepting it.
evals.expected_output: Runs spec/plan gates, builds a path matrix, reviews cross-ticket end-to-end behavior, persists review.md, findings.yaml, and per-ticket feedback, then returns pass or needs_fixes.

evals.prompt: Review a wave where the happy path works but validation failure creates a side effect that specs forbid.
evals.expected_output: Creates a blocking PATH or SPEC_DRIFT finding with expected vs actual behavior, evidence, owner ticket, fix boundary, and required verification.

evals.prompt: Review a cross-service Go backend and TypeScript frontend implementation where GraphQL nullability differs from the spec.
evals.expected_output: Creates a blocking INTERFACE finding for cross-layer type/nullability drift and routes actionable feedback to the responsible ticket.

evals.prompt: Review a wave but the plan does not identify which ticket owns a security issue.
evals.expected_output: Blocks with a PLAN finding routed to the planner instead of giving vague chat feedback or asking the implementation agent to decide ownership.

evals.prompt: Review a wave where failure recovery retries forever, logs restricted payloads at info level, and can leave a partially written record.
evals.expected_output: Creates blocking security/privacy, robustness, and data-integrity findings with evidence, owner tickets, fix boundaries, and required verification.

evals.prompt: Review a wave that passes functional tests but lacks requirement traceability, rollback evidence, runbook handoff, dependency policy, and SBOM/provenance artifacts required by specs.
evals.expected_output: Creates blocking traceability, production/release, and supply-chain findings with owner tickets, evidence, fix boundaries, and required verification.

evals.prompt: Review a wave where the API works but the feature is unreachable in the frontend, lacks error/loading states, and uses custom styles instead of the approved design system.
evals.expected_output: Creates blocking FRONTEND_UX or SPEC_DRIFT findings with spec refs, evidence, owner tickets, fix boundaries, and required verification.

evals.prompt: Review a wave where tests were added after implementation and do not trace to contracts, acceptance criteria, or unhappy-path definitions.
evals.expected_output: Creates blocking TEST or TRACEABILITY findings requiring spec/contract-derived test-first evidence and missing unhappy-path tests before acceptance.

evals.prompt: Review auth tenancy where middleware sets tenantId but repository get(id) does not constrain by tenant.
evals.expected_output: Creates a blocking SECURITY finding for adapter/resource isolation, requiring cross-tenant known-id, list, write/delete, owner-only, and revoked-session negative tests.

evals.prompt: Review a ticket that hand-edited generated frontend API types instead of exporting OpenAPI and regenerating the client.
evals.expected_output: Creates blocking INTERFACE or SPEC_DRIFT finding with root_cause implementation_drift or tooling_gap, requiring generation command evidence and drift check.

evals.prompt: Review http.ts after OAuth provider exchange, cookie policy, session persistence, CSRF, workspace, invitation, and raw adapter logic were added there.
evals.expected_output: Creates blocking MAINTAINABILITY/SPEC_DRIFT finding for monolithic composition drift and routes by root cause to implementation or planner.

evals.prompt: Review a clean backend rebuild wave where handlers compile but payloads use map[string]any, TypeScript clients use unknown, service manifests were handwritten, and generator drift checks were skipped.
evals.expected_output: Creates blocking INTERFACE/SPEC_DRIFT/TEST findings for weak closed-boundary types, handwritten generated mirrors, missing generator tests, compile/drift evidence, and routes fixes to the responsible tickets or planner/spec gaps.

evals.prompt: Review a clean rebuild that keeps legacy aliases and fallback synthesis even though specs accepted breaking changes and selected a generated new boundary.
evals.expected_output: Creates blocking SPEC_DRIFT or MAINTAINABILITY findings for stale compatibility paths without approved migration scope and requires removal or a spec-approved migration ticket with tests.

evals.prompt: Review a wave that adds UserSummary, a hand-written mapper, and a new API response even though the approved catalog already maps identity.user to the dashboard projection.
evals.expected_output: Creates blocking representation-reuse/spec-drift findings for the unregistered semantic duplicate and mapper, cites the catalog/ticket refs, and requires reuse or a spec-approved new representation with mapping tests.

evals.prompt: Review a ticket that changed a shared public User schema and ran a networked migration command, but has no matching digest, consumer impact evidence, or approval reference for the external command.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the review until the implementation-evidence manifest pins approved digests, maps the changed schema to approved assets and consumers, records affected verification, and supplies an approved decision for the external command; the implementer cannot mark the ticket accepted.
